$comment: Verified application ownership declarations for all packages/domain leaves, enforced by bun run check:owners (scripts/check-owners.ts). Every leaf requires a real value-importing application consumer. Deferrals, test-only consumers and empty or ancestor paths are refused. Public API and connected rehearsal proofs are retained separately in docs/plans/evidence/domain-owner-completion. Do not delete a leaf or weaken the guard to silence missing ownership.

leaves.note: NEXT-10 owner apps/api/src/application/banking/source-revisions.ts composes the leaf at the interpretation, revision-application and admission boundaries, over the immutable revision, case and admission rows and the version-guarded observation head in 0037-next-10-source-revisions.sql. The amount is derived from the retained provider page bytes, never from the request. Admission adopts an existing statement-backed observation with cited evidence and never creates a second one. Nothing posts, matches or reverses.

NEXT-09 owner apps/api/src/application/banking/sync-windows.ts composes the leaf at the claim, page and publication boundaries, over a per-consent stream pointer and the immutable generation/page/candidate/publication rows in 0036-next-09-sync-windows.sql. Claim, page append and publication are three short transactions with no provider call inside them; the persistent Bun job owns the HTTP call. The published cursor moves only with its publication marker, so a staged generation is never a reviewed bank observation.

Composed into the shared API contract: packages/contracts/src/accounting.ts re-exports this leaf's schemas and apps/api consumes those contracts. The reachable owner is the contract layer, not a directly importing application module. roundHalfUp is the shared half-up owner for the exchange-rates, mileage-reimbursement and peppol-exchange leaves; verification/bend compares it with its exact model.

NEXT-45 owner apps/api/src/application/reports/cash-flow-statement.ts composes the leaf from retained postings read through apps/api/src/db/reports/cash-flow-statement.ts inside the caller's transaction, exposed as POST /v1/entities/:entityId/books/:bookId/cash-flow. Opening and closing cash are derived from retained journal lines, never accepted from the request. Read-only, so no migration.

NEXT-27 owner apps/api/src/application/commerce/party-identity.ts extends the party directory with reviewed resolutions and balance views. It derives members from retained counterparty revisions with all identifiers honestly unverified, requires cited retained evidence for same-entity claims, and groups retained open obligations without netting. No new table; receipts in command_receipts.

It derives the instruction per export item from retained bytes, reads the retained outcome chain, and records receipts in command_receipts. It posts, allocates and moves nothing. No proof branch is currently satisfiable, so resolution reports unknown and replacement is gated; both are exercised.

NEXT-31 owner apps/api/src/application/subledger/prepayments.ts composes the leaf at the cost-basis, accrual and invoice-resolution boundaries, extending the existing subledger schedule owner rather than adding a second scheduling engine. The schedule, its revisions and its occurrences stay where the released owner put them; 0039-next-31-prepayments.sql records only the link and the resolution. The expense cost excludes deductible input VAT, so deferring changes expense timing and never a VAT tax point, and no tax fact is created. A residual is a computed difference.
